operators.name: mean_dim1_keepdim

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: [B, C, H, W] where C is positive (typically 3)

semantics: Computes mean over channel dimension (dim=1) with keepdim=True, exactly matching torch.mean(x, dim=1, keepdim=True).
Output shape is [B, 1, H, W] and dtype float32.
Reduction is over C elements for each (b, h, w).

operators.name: tile_dim1
semantics: Tiles the input along dimension 1 by the specified repeats factor, exactly matching torch.tile(x, (1, repeats, 1, 1)).
Output shape is [B, repeats, H, W].
The singleton dimension is expanded; all other dimensions unchanged.
No data transformation; identical values across repeats.
Reduce along channel dimension (dim=1) with keepdim=True.
Input shape [512, 3, 256, 256] float32 -> output shape [512, 1, 256, 256] float32.
Mean computed as sum over C divided by C.
Tile the singleton dimension 1 by factor 8.
Resulting tensor has stride [524288, 65536, 256, 1] as per reference, indicating non-contiguous view (broadcasted along dim1).
